math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}\because\ \left(x+1\right)^{2}+ax^{5}=\left(x^{2}+1\right)+\left(a x^{5}+2 x\right)\\\therefore\ f(x)=1+\frac{a x^{5}+2 x}{x^{2}+1}\\h(-x)=\frac{a(-x)^{5}+2(-x)}{(-x)^{2}+1}\\h(-x)=\frac{- a x^{5}- 2 x}{x^{2}+1}=-h(x)\\\therefore\ h(x)\text{ 是奇函数}\\\therefore\ f(x)+f(-x)=\left(1+h(x)\right)+\left(1-h(x)\right)=2\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 求 $f(x)+f(-x)$

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}\text{设 }h(t)=G\text{ 是 }h(x)\text{ 的最大值}\\\because\ h\text{ 是奇函数}\\\therefore\ h(-x)=-h(x)\ge -G\text{，且 }h(-t)=-G\\\therefore\ h(x)_{\min}=-G\\\because\ f(x)=1+h(x)\\\therefore\ M=1+G\text{，}m=1- G\\\therefore\ M+m=\left(1+G\right)+\left(1- G\right)=2\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 求 $M+m$
